comment: Independent C-first dwarvish Archeologist with mention_map (a11y.glyph_updates). A wished fountain sits in the lit room; a debug-created fog cloud engulfs the hero, who destroys it from inside. mon.c unstuck() then calls docrt(), whose vision_recalc(2), remembered-map redraw, vision_recalc(0) and see_monsters() all run with program_state.in_docrt set, so show_glyph() reports no notice for the fountain or stairs the redraw marks dirty. C shows a quiet map after the destroy message.
